label: 四个独立固定柔性裙边吸附模块：未标定的降阶模型
assumptions: The modules are fixed to the chassis, not tire material and not an invented rotating suction wheel.
Each module has an actual 16-capsule colliding lip; its enclosed effective area is pi times inner radius squared.

The rigid backplate has real collision. Cavity volume integrates the inner cross-section of the actual capsule polygon up to the underside of that plate; the smaller circular area is a conservative pressure-force area.
The lip soft-contact time constant, travel, friction and microscopic hydraulic gap are editable assumptions, not elastomer FEM or calibrated seal measurements.
Lip contact priority is above the default world surface priority so native contact uses the declared low friction and soft solref instead of MuJoCo maximum-friction and solmix averaging.
The hydraulic radial path is bounded by the actual lip tube diameter, not the wider backplate annulus; loaded real contact width may be smaller.
The 30 gram module mass is a declared fixture assumption and is separate from pump, valves and plumbing mass.
Gap sampling uses native world geometry along the module face normal. A missing surface remains a large open gap rather than a contact boolean.
Pressure acts on the module backplate, not on the wheel or whichever surface happens to touch a tire.
The viscous-plus-inertial series resistance is an engineering surrogate; its small-gap limit is the cited thin-slit leakage law.

sources.use: Section 4.1.2 equation 13: annular thin-slit leakage is proportional to gap cubed. No J100 seal calibration is supplied.
Published rolling-seal mechanism uses a flexible track as sealing skirt; ordinary cylindrical tire contact is not that mechanism.
Primary experimental study of rough-surface suction cup failure and leakage; does not calibrate this fixture.
Native surface ray queries for geometric clearance.
